image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a pile of golden-brown bagels. The foreground features a prominent bagel with a textured, blistered crust and scattered coarse toppings (likely salt or sugar). Behind it, several other bagels are stacked, showing their toroidal shapes and glossy surfaces. The lighting highlights the sheen on the crusts, indicating a boiled-then-baked preparation.
